title: puck t_echo_nrf52840.conf sets CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_LOCATION=y but prj.conf STANDALONE=y forces it n (dead line)
description: Two independent codereview passes on s8rl flagged: lichen/apps/puck/boards/t_echo_nrf52840.conf:122 sets CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_LOCATION=y (added 35b8c194eb, 2026-07-19), but lichen/apps/puck/prj.conf:24 sets CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_STANDALONE=y (added 6bdacf9d2d, 2026-08-31) and LICHEN_COAP_LOCATION depends on !LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_STANDALONE -- so Kconfig forces LOCATION=n with an unsatisfied-deps warning on every puck t_echo build. The /sensors/location resource has never been compiled into that build. Decision: (a) drop the dead LOCATION=y line from the board conf, or (b) if the resource is wanted on puck t_echo, the modular-mode respond path (who provides lichen_coap_respond when STANDALONE=n) must be resolved first -- that is a real architectural gap since coap_server.c (STANDALONE-only) holds the sole production definition.
